cohort: 38,541 live births and 776 neonatal deaths occurring between January 1, 2008 and December 30, 2019 in the Kersa Health Demographic Surveillance System (KHDSS) in Ethiopia
finding: Neonatal mortality rate was 20.3 (95% CI: 18.9-21.8) per 1000 live births and declined over the study period.
gest_age: Preterm newborns had increased risk of mortality.
birth_weight: Low birthweight was associated with increased risk of neonatal death.
